page.overview:
Who is Andal?

Born in the 60s AG she fought in several battles against the Fire Army.

By late 99 AG, Andal had set up headquarters in Pebble Pond Village, planning a military operation against a Fire Army outpost commanded by General Yuze. As she did so, the officer was surprised upon being informed that a squad of Kyoshi Warriors had come to Pebble Pond Village, requesting to join the Earth Kingdom Army. Andal gave the group an audience, where the officer mixed mild criticism of Kyoshi Island's non-intervention in the war up to this point with praise for the evident eagerness of the young warriors. The general particularly praised the squad's leader, Suki, and offered the group a place in the local army unit. The Kyoshi Warriors agreed to the offer.

On the next day, Andal readied the troops for the attack on Yuze's outpost. Expressing a conviction that victory would be theirs this time, the general was approached by Suki who requested that one young child soldier, Bun, be left at the camp during the upcoming operation. Hearing Suki's concerns about Bun lacking martial abilities, Andal countered that the boy was eager to fight but allowed him to decide for himself. The officer watched in satisfaction as Bun reprimanded Suki for trying to keep him out of a battle, lauding his fighting spirit as "very honorable". Afterward, Andal also demanded that the Kyoshi Warriors swap their traditional outfits and weaponry for standard army equipment, firmly stating that all soldiers had to fight in a uniform way as "one boulder is deadlier than a handful of pebbles". She told her young aide to provide the warriors with the items in question.

After all the soldiers, including Suki's squad, were ready, Andal personally led them toward the frontline. On the way, the advancing troops ran into a retreating contingent of wounded Earth Kingdom soldiers. The general praised these survivors before continuing the advance. Upon seeing that Suki's squad had stopped to provide additional medical aid to one heavily wounded soldier, Andal demanded that the Kyoshi Warriors close ranks. When Fume argued that this soldier needed more immediate aid and expressed doubts about the capacities of the field hospital at Pebble Pond Village, the general repeated her order more forcefully before moving on.
